manifest.purpose: Secure replacement for inputs/ladder_swap.cpp. Implements `void conditional_swap(uint32_t *P, uint32_t *Q, int n, unsigned int ctrl_bit)` (exact signature preserved, includes only <cstdint>,<cstddef>, no main). Uses branchless masking: uint32_t mask = (uint32_t)0 - (uint32_t)(ctrl_bit & 1u); then for i in [0,n) compute t = mask & (P[i]^Q[i]); P[i]^=t; Q[i]^=t. No if/ternary/short-circuit conditioned on ctrl_bit anywhere; loop trip count and memory access sequence identical for ctrl_bit=0 and 1, satisfying FR1-FR4 and SR1-SR3. No dynamic allocation, no I/O, no globals touched besides P/Q contents.
